C-CALIBRATION-PROVENANCE.Summary: Phase 9 round 3 (A61): make adjudicatedAt a real provenance field (read from the record; express backfill; exclude backfilled pairs from computation), restate the hand-migrated C-CALIBRATION Epoch-1 as backfill without editing the archive, and observe one genuine fold-time CalibrationAdjudication written by fold (corr 160–161).
C-CALIBRATION-PROVENANCE.Problem:
Round 2 closed 155/156 correctly, but two defects remain in Phase 9's own surface:
1. Corr 160 / 151 not closed. Epoch-1 of C-CALIBRATION was folded before CalibrationAdjudication existed. The archive record was hand-written during migration after the change had already passed. The fold path is unit-tested and has never run on a live change. A46.4: a path never observed succeeding is not a path. The corpus's only pair is contaminated (scored retroactively against a known outcome) — D6 condition 2.
2. Corr 161. adjudicatedAt is typed as a single-valued constant and the parser synthesizes "fold" at parse time rather than reading the attribute. The field cannot express backfill and would print fold for a record that said otherwise. Same construction A48 already ruled on for D15's stage field.
Archive is immutable (CLAUDE.md). Correction is by superseding provenance via a restatement owned by this change, never by editing the archive.

Goals.Goal: adjudicatedAt is read from the CalibrationAdjudication record and accepts fold | backfill (A61 corr 161).
Backfilled pairs are excluded from calibration computation and counted on their own line; never silently pooled with fold-time pairs.
Both directions (A7.2): fold-time records report fold and enter included; backfilled records report backfill and do not enter included.
C-CALIBRATION Epoch-1 is restated as backfill via this bundle; archive untouched.
One genuine fold-time CalibrationAdjudication is written by fold when this change's epoch is folded — not by hand, not by migration, not by fixture alone (A61 corr 160 / A46.4).
Root lint 0/0, bun test and validate:ci green.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not hand-write this change's CalibrationAdjudication; fold must write it.
claimedConfidence remains write-only; no gate may consume it.
Labels remain stored, never recomputed at report time (corr 156 still holds).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Authority axis (user-stated | tool-verified | agent-inferred) — still deferred.
Held-out calibration study or any gate consumption of claimedConfidence.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ADJUDICATED-AT-READ: Parser reads adjudicatedAt from the record; fold and backfill are distinct values.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-BACKFILL-EXCLUDED: Backfilled pairs are not included in calibration computation; counted separately.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-BOTH-DIRECTIONS: Fold-time → included with adjudicatedAt=fold; backfill → backfilled, not included.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-RESTATE-EPOCH1: C-CALIBRATION Epoch-1 reports as backfilled; archive XML still says fold on disk.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REAL-FOLD: This change's ledger contains CalibrationAdjudication written by foldEpoch, with adjudicatedAt=fold, observed in doctor as an included pair.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-VALIDATE-CI: bun run validate:ci green; root lint 0 errors 0 warnings.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: adjudicatedAt read from record (fold|backfill); backfilled count separate from included; restatement of C-CALIBRATION Epoch-1 without archive edit; live CalibrationAdjudication written by fold on this change with adjudicatedAt=fold; root lint 0/0; validate:ci green.
